name: codex-pair
description: Codex CLI as Claude Code's independent second model: grounded judgment, product shaping, adversarial plan and diff review, and a technical-lead loop where Codex scopes and signs off while Claude implements.

interface.shortDescription: Independent product shaping, technical leadership, and review for Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Runs Codex as a persistent per-branch thread in one of five read-only roles: grounded second opinion, product-and-technical shaping, adversarial plan review, technical lead that authors a bounded slice spec and later reviews the diff against it, and adversarial diff review. Claude Code remains the outer loop and sole code author; Codex supplies independent scope, challenge, and sign-off.
defaultPrompt: Scope the next slice as tech lead, then review my diff against that spec.
Shape the smallest product slice worth building before we plan implementation.
Red-team this implementation plan against the actual code.
Give me a grounded second opinion — here is my position, attack it.
